text: Sintel survives a blizzard and is taken in by a mysterious shaman in a mountain shelter.
Sintel begins her search for the dragon Scales, who was taken from her.
A flashback shows Sintel finding Scales as a baby and raising him as her companion.
An adult dragon takes Scales away, sending Sintel on a determined pursuit.
Sintel travels across harsh landscapes while following the trail of the missing dragon.
Sintel reaches the dragon's lair and prepares to confront the creature inside.
A fierce battle unfolds between Sintel and the dragon she believes took Scales.
Sintel realizes that the defeated adult dragon is Scales, grown and unable to recognize her.
After the tragic realization, Sintel leaves the lair and begins the journey home.
Closing credits roll as the Sintel film concludes.
